lead_editorial.title: Oman ke tat par ek Bharatiya naavik ki maut — samudri raaston ki suraksha ab kootneeti ki sabse badi praathmikta honi chahiye
lead_editorial.summary: Hormuz aur Oman ke aaspaas jahazon par hamle ab sirf tel ki keemat ka mudda nahi rahe; inki keemat Bharatiya parivaar apni jaan dekar chuka rahe hain.
body: Somvaar shaam Oman ke Limah ke paas Bharatiya jhande waale jahaz MSV Al Jusufi par ek 'aggyat hawaai cheez' giri. Jahaz par savaar 14 Bharatiya naavikon mein se Gujarat ke Gandhar Nahim Ajij ki maut ho gayi, baaki 13 ko Omani Coast Guard ne bachaaya. Videsh mantralaya ne hamle ki ninda ki hai aur samudri vyapar par hamle rokne ki apeel ki hai.

Yeh ghatna kisi ek jahaz tak seemit nahi hai. CBS News ke mutabik UKMTO ne October mein vyaapaarik jahazon par 30 hamle darj kiye — ab tak ka record. Laakhon Bharatiya naavik duniya bhar ke jahazon par kaam karte hain aur Khaadi ke raaste Bharat ki urja aapoorti ki reedh hain. Jab jang ke maidan mein samundar ki galiyaan bhi shaamil ho jaayein, to sabse pehle khatra inhi logon ko hota hai.

Isi beech America ne Qeshm Island par 'defensive' hamle kiye hain aur saath hi Iran ke saath baatcheet mein pragati ka daava bhi kar raha hai. Yeh do-dhaari raaj neeti samajh mein aati hai, lekin har nayi jhadap ka matlab hai samundar mein aur zyada anishchitata. Bharat ne G7 mein bhi naavikon ki suraksha ka mudda uthaya tha; ab zaroorat hai ki is awaaz ko thos kadmon mein badla jaaye — naval escort, beema aur crew ke liye spasht protocol, aur madhyasthon ke saath sakriya samvaad.

Hamari raay mein Bharat ki kootneeti ka imtihaan yahi hai ki woh kisi paksh mein khade hue bina apne nagrikon ki suraksha kitni prabhavi dhang se sunishchit kar paata hai. Gandhar Ajij ke parivaar ke prati samvedna ke saath, sarkaar se yeh ummeed jaayaz hai ki survivors aur unke parivaaron ki madad mein koi deri na ho, aur aisi ghatnaon ki nishpaksh jaanch ki maang antarrashtriya manch par pukhta tareeke se rakhi jaaye.

stories.title: Murasu ke baad Andhra mein rahat aur bahaali par zor: CM Naidu ke mutabik Arnab aur Murasu se Rs 4,526 crore ka nuksaan, ab tak koi maut nahi
stories.summary: Severe cyclonic storm Murasu ne Tuesday tadke Ongole ke paas tat paar kiya. Prakasam aur Bapatla mein ped, bijli ke khambhe aur fasal tabaah hui; AP disaster authority ke mutabik ab tak kisi ki jaan nahi gayi.
body: IMD ke mutabik Cyclone Murasu ne Tuesday tadke Andhra Pradesh ke Prakasam zile mein Ongole ke paas tat paar kiya. Al Jazeera ne AP State Disaster Management Authority ke MD Prakhar Jain ke hawale se bataaya ki ab tak kisi maut ya chot ki khabar nahi hai. Prashasan ne Somvaar se lagbhag 30,000 logon ko surakshit jagah pahunchaane ki yojana par kaam shuru kiya tha. Prakasam aur Bapatla mein hazaaron ped gire, saikdon bijli ke khambhe toote, machhuaaron ki naavein kshatigrast hui aur fasalon ko nuksaan pahuncha. Down To Earth ki report ke mutabik Bapatla, Prakasam aur Krishna mein storm surge aur Ongole mandal mein samundar ka paani andar aane ki khabrein hain.

Telugu portal Andhra Pravasi ki report ke mutabik CM N. Chandrababu Naidu ne Arnab aur Murasu — ek hafte ke andar aaye do toofanon — se kul nuksaan Rs 4,526 crore aanka hai aur Kendra ko antarim report bheji gayi hai. Report ke mutabik lagbhag 3.52 lakh hectare kheti aur 23,211 hectare baagwaani ki zameen prabhavit hui, kareeb 31,000 bijli ke khambhe gire aur 4,095 gaon ki bijli gul hui. 17 zilon ki 19,265 ration dukaanon mein do mahine ka zaroori saamaan bhara gaya hai.

Grih Mantri Amit Shah ne Naidu se baat karke Kendra ki taraf se madad ka bharosa diya hai; NDRF aur SDRF ki teamein zameen par hain. IMD ne kai zilon mein bhaari se bahut bhaari baarish ki chetavani di hai aur toofan ke kamzor hokar Tuesday-Wednesday ki raat tak deep depression banne ka anumaan jataaya hai. Tamil Nadu, Puducherry aur Odisha mein bhi baarish ka asar hai.

stories.title: Oman ke tat ke paas Bharatiya jahaz MSV Al Jusufi par 'aggyat hawaai cheez' se hamla, Gujarat ke naavik Gandhar Ajij ki maut; 13 crew surakshit
stories.summary: Jahaz par 14 Bharatiya savaar the. Shipping Mantri Sarbananda Sonowal ne maut ki pushti ki; MEA ne hamle ki ninda karte hue tanaav kam karne ki apeel ki.
body: Bharatiya jhande waala jahaz MSV Al Jusufi Somvaar shaam Oman ke Limah ke paas ek 'aggyat hawaai cheez' ki chapet mein aa gaya. Jahaz par savaar 14 Bharatiya naavikon mein se Gujarat ke Gandhar Nahim Ajij ki chot ke kaaran maut ho gayi, jabki baaki 13 ko Omani Coast Guard ne bacha liya. Hamla kisne kiya, iski aadhikaarik jaankaari abhi saamne nahi aayi hai.

Kendriya Shipping Mantri Sarbananda Sonowal ne maut ki pushti karte hue parivaar ke prati samvedna jataayi. Videsh mantralaya ne Tuesday ko bayaan jaari kar hamle ki ninda ki aur kaha ki Oman mein Bharatiya dootavaas sthaaniya adhikaariyon ke saath milkar bache hue crew aur mritak ke shav ki jald vaapsi ka intezaam kar raha hai. MEA ne tanaav kam karne aur vyaapaarik jahazon par hamle band karne ki apeel bhi ki.

Business Today ki report ke mutabik IMO aur UKMTO ke aankde batate hain ki sangharsh shuru hone ke baad se 120 se zyada vyaapaarik jahazon par hamle ho chuke hain. Yeh ghatna aise samay hui hai jab Hormuz mein America aur Iran ke beech tanaav aur baatcheet dono saath-saath chal rahe hain.

stories.title: PM Modi ne Pune Metro ki 23 km lambi Hinjewadi-Shivajinagar 'Pink Line' ka virtual udghatan kiya; Phase-II ke chaar corridor ki neenv bhi rakhi
stories.summary: Rs 8,300 crore se zyada ki laagat waali line par shuruaat mein 17 station khulenge aur yatri seva Budhvaar se shuru hogi. Modi bole — pehle garibi hataane ke naare the, ab zameen par kaam ho raha hai.
body: Pradhan Mantri Narendra Modi ne Tuesday ko Pune Metro ki Pink Line ka virtual udghatan kiya, jo Maan aur Hinjewadi IT hub ko Shivajinagar aur District Court metro station se jodti hai. Business Today ke mutabik 23 km lambi is line ki laagat Rs 8,300 crore se zyada hai, shuruaat mein 17 station khulenge aur yatriyon ke liye seva 4 November se shuru hogi. PM ne lagbhag Rs 13,500 crore ke chaar Phase-II corridor ki neenv bhi rakhi.

Report ke mutabik is corridor ko poori tarah mahila train operator chalayengi aur iski kareeb 30% bijli solar urja se aane ki yojana hai. Aaj Tak ki report ke mutabik apne sambodhan mein Modi ne kaha ki 2014 tak sirf paanch shaharon mein metro thi aur ab desh ke 26 shaharon mein metro network hai, jismein rozaana ek crore se zyada log safar karte hain. Unhone Pune ko IT, auto, pharma aur startups ka bada kendra bataaya.

editorial.title: Ek hafte mein do toofan: Andhra ne jaanein bachaane mein misaal pesh ki, ab asli kasauti bahaali aur muaavze ki hai
body: Arnab ke baad sirf ek hafte mein Murasu ka aana kisi bhi prashasan ke liye kathin pariksha hai. Shuruaati khabron ke mutabik Murasu se ab tak kisi ki jaan nahi gayi — yeh samay par chetavani, evacuation aur zameen par tainaat teamon ki mehnat ka nateeja hai, aur iski saraahna honi chahiye.

Lekin jaan bachaane ke baad aajeevika bachaane ki baari aati hai. Lakhon hectare fasal, toote ghar, kshatigrast naavein aur hazaaron gaon mein bijli ka sankat — in sab ka asar mahino tak rahega. Hamari raay mein Kendra aur rajya ko nuksaan ke aakalan ko raajneeti se door rakhkar tezi se muaavza aur beema daavon ka nipataara karna chahiye, taaki kisaan aur machhuaare agle season se pehle phir khade ho saken.

Lagaataar aate toofan yeh bhi yaad dilaate hain ki tatiya ilaakon mein mazboot bijli network, cyclone shelter aur mangrove jaise praakritik suraksha kavach mein lambi avadhi ka nivesh ab vikalp nahi, zaroorat hai.

stories.title: America ne Hormuz ke paas Iran ke Qeshm Island par kiye 'seemit defensive' hamle; Vance bole — baatcheet mein 'kuch pragati', Tehran ne kaha ab faisla Washington ka
stories.summary: US adhikaariyon ke mutabik yeh hamle Revolutionary Guard dwara ek American vimaan par firing ke jawaab mein the. Qatar aur Pakistan ki madhyasthata mein teen din ki baatcheet mein abhi koi breakthrough nahi.
body: CBS News ne kai US adhikaariyon ke hawale se bataaya ki American sena ne Somvaar shaam Strait of Hormuz ke paas Iranian thikaanon par 'seemit, defensive' hamle kiye. Ek varishth sainya adhikaari ke mutabik nishaana dakshini Iran ka Qeshm Island tha, aur yeh karrvaai Iran ke Revolutionary Guard dwara ek American vimaan par firing ke jawaab mein ki gayi. AP ke hawale se Al Jazeera ne kaha ki US assets ko surface-to-air missile ke khatre ke baad yeh kadam uthaya gaya.

Isi beech US Upraashtrapati JD Vance ne kaha ki Iran ke saath paroksh baatcheet mein 'kuch pragati' hui hai. Iran ke videsh mantralaya ke pravakta Esmaeil Baqaei ne kaha ki ab agla kadam Washington ko uthaana hai. Videsh Mantri Abbas Araghchi ne chetavani di ki agar America sainya karrvaai karta hai to Iran pehle se zyada sakhti se jawaab dega. Iran ki shartein hain — frozen assets ki rihaai, naval blockade aur pratibandh hatana; badle mein woh Hormuz kholne aur parmaanu kaaryakram par baat karne ko taiyaar hai.

CBS ke mutabik Qatar, Pakistan aur anya madhyasthon ki agvaai mein lagaataar teen din band kamron mein baatcheet hui, lekin koi breakthrough nahi hua. Report ke mutabik Israel ke PM Netanyahu midterms ke baad naye hamlon ke liye Trump par dabaav bana rahe hain, jabki Trump ne abhi faisla nahi kiya hai. Deal ki ummeed mein Somvaar ko Brent crude 7.4% girkar $105.03 prati barrel par aa gaya tha.

stories.title: America mein midterms ki voting jaari: 5.7 crore se zyada log pehle hi daal chuke vote; Michigan, Georgia aur Texas jaise rajyon par sabki nazar
stories.summary: Poore 435 House seats, 35 Senate seats aur 36 governor padon ke liye matdaan. Senate mein Republicans ke paas 53 seatein aur House mein maamooli bahumat hai.
body: America mein Tuesday ko midterm chunaav ke liye matdaan shuru ho gaya. Al Jazeera ke mutabik sabse pehle Vermont, New Jersey, Virginia, Connecticut aur Kentucky mein booth khule. House ki sabhi 435 seaton, Senate ki 100 mein se 35 seaton aur 36 rajyon mein governor ke liye vote daale ja rahe hain. 5.7 crore (57 million) se zyada Americans pehle hi early voting mein hissa le chuke hain, jismein Georgia, Michigan, North Carolina, Ohio aur Texas sabse aage rahe.

Filhaal Senate mein Republicans ke paas 53 aur Democrats tatha unke saath baithne waale nirdaliyon ke paas 47 seatein hain; House mein Republicans ka bahumat sirf chaar seaton ka hai. Democrats ne mehangaai aur Iran jang khatm karne ke mudde par prachaar kiya hai. Report ke mutabik President Trump ki approval rating record nichle star ke kareeb hai, aur itihaas mein midterms aksar satta-dhaari party ke liye mushkil rahe hain. Michigan Senate race khaas charcha mein hai, jahan Democrat Haley Stevens ne Republican Mike Rogers ka samarthan kiya hai. Nateeje Bharat mein Budhvaar subah se aane shuru honge.

editorial.title: Ek haath mein missile, doosre mein samjhauta — Hormuz mein bharosa banaane ka yeh tareeka jokhim bhara hai
body: Washington ka daava hai ki Qeshm par hamle 'defensive' the, aur saath hi woh baatcheet mein pragati bhi gina raha hai. Tehran kehta hai ki gend ab America ke paale mein hai. Dono baatein sach ho sakti hain, lekin zameen par nateeja yeh hai ki samundar mein jahaz jal rahe hain aur naavik mar rahe hain.

Hamari raay mein midterms ke din tak tanaav ko 'control' mein dikhaane ki koshish aur chunaav ke baad naye hamlon ki charcha — yeh sanket madhyasthon ki mehnat ko kamzor karte hain. Agar dono paksh sach mein samjhauta chahte hain, to pehla kadam Hormuz mein vyaapaarik jahazon par hamle rokne ka saajha vaada hona chahiye. Bharat jaise desh, jinke naavik aur urja dono is raaste par nirbhar hain, ko is maang ko madhyasthon ke saath zor-shor se uthaana chahiye.

stories.title: Baazaar mein lagaataar chauthe din tezi: Sensex 1,225 ank uchhalkar 76,918 par, Nifty 23,811 par band; FMCG sabse aage, NSE companiyon ka mcap Rs 4.7 lakh crore badha
stories.summary: Sasta crude, videshi niveshakon ki kharidari aur FMCG sheyaron mein josh se baazaar chadha. Nestle, Tata Consumer aur Asian Paints top gainers; Power Grid aur SBI mein giraavat.
body: Upstox ki market wrap ke mutabik Tuesday ko Sensex 1,225.07 ank (1.62%) chadhkar 76,917.85 par aur Nifty 50 370.05 ank (1.58%) badhkar 23,810.85 par band hua — yeh lagaataar chautha din tha jab baazaar hare nishaan mein raha. NSE par listed companiyon ka kul market cap Rs 4.71 lakh crore badhkar Rs 483.1 lakh crore ho gaya. Midcap 100 mein 1.06% aur Smallcap 100 mein 0.31% ki badhat rahi.

Sectors mein FMCG 3.65% ke saath sabse aage raha, uske baad Realty, Private Bank aur Auto. Nifty par BSE (5.03%), Nestle India, Tata Consumer Products, Asian Paints aur Bharti Airtel top gainers rahe, jabki Power Grid (-3.04%), SBI, ONGC aur Adani Enterprises mein giraavat aayi. PSU Bank index 1.27% gira.

Report ke mutabik crude ka $105 prati barrel ke aaspaas rehna aur FIIs ki kharidari — Somvaar ko unhone Rs 3,114.68 crore ke share kharide — tezi ki badi wajah rahe. India VIX 1.09% badhkar 15.67 par raha, jo America ke midterms aur Iran se judi khabron ko lekar savdhaani ka sanket hai.

stories.title: SBI ka September timahi ka munafa 14.3% badhkar Rs 23,038 crore; NII 14.7% upar, gross NPA ghatkar 1.39% par
stories.summary: Desh ke sabse bade bank ke loan mein saal-dar-saal lagbhag 18% ki badhat; domestic NIM 11 basis point sudhar kar 3.11% par pahuncha.
body: State Bank of India ne Tuesday ko July-September timahi (Q2 FY27) ke nateeje jaari kiye. IIFL ki report ke mutabik bank ka standalone shuddh munafa 14.3% badhkar Rs 23,038 crore raha, jabki net interest income 14.7% badhkar Rs 49,143 crore pahunchi. Gross NPA pichhli timahi ke 1.47% se ghatkar 1.39% aur net NPA 0.38% se ghatkar 0.36% par aa gaya.

Bank ke kul advances mein saal-dar-saal 17.84% ki badhat hui aur domestic net interest margin 11 basis point sudhar kar 3.11% raha. Haalaanki report ke mutabik operating profit 1.4% ghatkar Rs 26,937 crore raha. Nateejon ke din SBI ka share Nifty ke top losers mein raha aur lagbhag 1.7% girkar band hua.

editorial.title: Chaar din ki tezi ka sahara sasta tel aur videshi paisa hai — dono hi Hormuz ki ek khabar se palat sakte hain
body: Sensex mein chaar din ki lagaataar badhat aur SBI jaise bade bank ke majboot nateeje Bharatiya arthvyavastha ki andaruni taakat dikhaate hain. Behtar asset quality aur loan growth yeh sanket dete hain ki banking system pichhle dashak ki tulna mein kahin zyada swasth hai.

Lekin hamari raay mein tezi ke peechhe ki do badi wajahein — crude mein giraavat aur FII ki kharidari — dono hi Iran-America baatcheet par tiki hain. Qeshm par hamle jaisi ek khabar ya midterms ka anapekshit nateeja in dono ko palat sakta hai. Rising VIX bhi yahi keh raha hai. Aise mein niveshakon aur neeti-nirmaataon dono ko lambi avadhi ke buniyaadi tatvon par nazar rakhni chahiye, na ki sirf headline-driven josh par. (Yeh nivesh salaah nahi hai.)

stories.title: Release se pehle 'Ramayana' ko kaanooni kavach: Bombay High Court ne online piracy ke khilaaf diya 'dynamic' injunction
stories.summary: Justice Madhav Jamdar ka aadesh — ISPs aur social media platforms ko notice milne par pirated links aur mirror websites block karni hongi. Ranbir Kapoor-Yash ki film 5 November ko release hogi.
body: MediaNama ki report ke mutabik Bombay High Court ke Justice Madhav Jamdar ne 2 November ko film 'Ramayana' ke liye 'dynamic ad-interim injunction' jaari kiya. Yaachika Mumbai ki Godpower Media Private Limited ne daakhil ki thi, jo Bharat aur anya kshetron mein film ke IP adhikaar hone ka daava karti hai. Aadesh aggyat vyaktiyon aur digital platforms ko film ki bina ijaazat recording, upload, streaming ya distribution se rokta hai.

Dynamic injunction ka matlab hai ki rights holder dwara likhit notice milne par ISPs aur social media platforms ko naye infringing links aur mirror websites bhi block ya hatani hongi — har baar naya court aadesh lene ki zaroorat nahi. Ranbir Kapoor aur Yash ki yeh film 5 November ko duniya bhar ke theatres mein release hone waali hai. Filmibeat ki report ke mutabik film ki advance booking zor-shor se chal rahi hai.

stories.title: Asian Champions Trophy: India ne South Korea ko 8-0 se raunda, league mein paanchon match jeete; Budhvaar ko semifinal mein phir Korea se muqabla
stories.summary: Jalandhar mein Dilpreet Singh ke do gol; India 15 ank aur +29 goal difference ke saath table mein sabse upar.
body: Khel Now ki report ke mutabik Jalandhar ke Olympian Surjit Singh Hockey Stadium mein Somvaar ko India ne South Korea ko 8-0 se haraakar league stage ka ant bina haare kiya. Dilpreet Singh ne 8ve aur 40ve minute mein do gol daage, jabki Jugraj Singh, captain Harmanpreet Singh, Shilanand Lakra, Sukhjeet Singh, Sanjay aur Angad Bir Singh ne ek-ek gol kiya.

India ne paanchon league match jeetkar 15 ank aur +29 ke goal difference ke saath pehla sthaan haasil kiya. Semifinal mein uska saamna phir South Korea se hoga — mukaabla 4 November ko shaam 7 baje Mohali ke Olympian Balbir Singh Senior International Hockey Stadium mein khela jaayega.

stories.title: Bharat bana ChatGPT ka duniya mein sabse bada baazaar, January se user base dogna: OpenAI India MD Prabhjeet Singh
stories.summary: Weekly active users ke hisaab se India ne sabko peechhe chhoda. OpenAI Bharatiya bhashaon, Android-first products aur aane waale hafton mein UPI se jude elaan par kaam kar rahi hai.
body: Inc42 ki report ke mutabik OpenAI India ke Managing Director Prabhjeet Singh ne ET se baatcheet mein kaha ki weekly active users ke hisaab se Bharat ab ChatGPT ka duniya mein sabse bada baazaar hai aur January 2026 se yahan user base dogna ho gaya hai. February mein OpenAI ne Bharat mein 10 crore se zyada weekly users hone ki baat kahi thi.

Report ke mutabik company Bharatiya bhashaon mein ChatGPT ki kshamata badha rahi hai, products Android-first soch ke saath bana rahi hai, aur UPI tatha payments se jude elaan aane waale hafton mein ho sakte hain. Bharat mein ChatGPT par ads ka bhi vistaar ho raha hai; Singh ne kaha ki advertisers ko users ki personal jaankaari nahi milegi aur ads jawaabon ko prabhavit nahi karenge.

editorial.title: ChatGPT ka sabse bada baazaar banna garv ki baat hai, par asli lakshya AI ka upbhokta nahi, nirmaata banna hona chahiye
body: Bharat ka ChatGPT ka sabse bada baazaar banna dikhaata hai ki sasta data aur smartphone ne technology ko kitni tezi se aam logon tak pahunchaaya hai. Bharatiya bhashaon aur UPI integration par zor se yeh pahunch aur badhegi.

Lekin hamari raay mein do sawaal zaroori hain. Pehla — ads aur payments jaise kadmon ke saath users ke data ki suraksha par spasht niyam aur nigraani ho. Doosra — itne bade user base ka faayda Bharatiya AI companiyon, researchers aur startups ko bhi mile, taaki desh sirf videshi AI ka bada grahak na rahe, balki apne models aur products bhi duniya ko de sake.
